entities.name: bL32 ribosomal protein
observations: The 59-residue query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt protein Q8D3B2 from Wigglesworthia glossinidia brevipalpis.
Homologs Q89AH1 and B8D9D5 are reviewed bacterial bL32 proteins with 68.5–74.1% identity over most of the sequence.
The query contains Pfam Ribosomal_L32p (PF01783.30) at positions 2–56 with i-Evalue 1.1e-17.
The protein is predicted to be highly basic: pI 10.69 and charge at pH 7 of +13.82; estimated molecular mass is 6.87 kDa.
UniProt-linked GO annotations support structural constituent of the large ribosomal subunit and involvement in translation.

entities.name: Bacterial translation
observations: Reviewed bL32 homologs are annotated with GO:0006412, translation.

entities.name: Large ribosomal subunit
observations: Reviewed bL32 homologs are annotated with GO:0015934, large ribosomal subunit.
